scope: Static inspection of retained publisher source snippets and the current package configuration; no installer or utility execution.

observations.finding: CalcDefaults calls g4wihelp::config_fetch_bool for selected component flags including inst_kleopatra, inst_okular, inst_gpgpass, inst_gpgoljs, inst_gpgol, inst_gpgex and inst_paperkey. This is the same configuration lookup path implicated by the previously reviewed upstream 5.1.1 report.
The installer parses /MINIMAL=, and the minimal branch explicitly unselects Kleopatra. That mode does not satisfy RIDE's approved GnuPG command-line plus Kleopatra package selection.
The package uses /S /CurrentUser with a generated /C configuration that selects Kleopatra and disables other optional integrations.

assessment.PriorWindows11Result: The 5.1.1 installer exited 0xC0000005; the guest evidence does not identify the failing module or prove that the configuration defect caused the crash.
assessment.Workaround: No source-backed workaround was established. /MINIMAL=1 is rejected because it unselects Kleopatra.
assessment.Disposition: Keep the package candidate and selected user scope unchanged. Do not repeat the same 5.1.1 component configuration as an expected pass. Revisit after a publisher fix or a separately documented and independently tested workaround.
assessment.LicenseDisposition: The prior RIDE v2 license-specialist approval covers RIDE's direct Microsoft download-and-install workflow. RIDE does not transfer or publish Sysinternals; Sysinternals has no legal migration blocker. This Gpg4win technical finding is unrelated to Sysinternals licensing.
assessment.DefenderDisposition: Defender-blocked tools remain separate security exclusions.

deferred: Gpg4win 5.1.1 user-scope install, recovery and crash diagnosis
partial: Gpg4win remains an unaccepted package candidate; the exact legacy outcome remains open
